en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a small wooden pedestrian bridge with diagonal cross-bracing spanning a tree-lined path or cutting. Light snow or fallen leaves cover the ground and banks on either side. Behind the bridge is a white picket fence and a multi-story building partly visible through bare trees. The card has printed vertical text along the right side of the image and a short handwritten note on the right margin.
